summary: The bill designates the existing Museum of the Blind People’s Movement at 200 East Wells Street in Baltimore, Maryland, as the National Museum of the Blind People’s Movement.

scores.thoughts: The bill designates an existing museum but contains no provisions authorizing appropriations, new federal spending, or budget changes. It is purely a symbolic naming act with no fiscal implications.
No provisions related to taxes, tax policy, or revenue measures appear in the bill.
